claims.statement: AKSK v2.0.0 (package name agent-knowledge-starter) is a shareable glue kit over two globally installed peer tools, not an application service: dependencies is empty, there is no runtime service or database, and npm test intentionally prints an error and exits 1.

Peer dependencies are Node >=22, @fission-ai/openspec and openwiki globally installed per-user via npm i -g plus openwiki --init per repo; check_peer_tools.mjs never installs and fails fast with exact npm i -g commands on exit 2, while bootstrap-global.mjs (global lane) attempts the global install with caret versions resolved via versionsFromPackageJson() from aksk-bootstrap/references/versions.json (single source; aksk-init reuses it without duplicating versions.json) and falls back to printed INSTRUCT lane when it cannot run, skipping tools already present; bootstrap-repo.mjs verifies globals, never installs them, and partitions INSTRUCT to repo-only commands.

openwiki/ is optional JIT context, not required startup reading; source code and .agents/skills contracts (SKILL.md/CONTRACT.md) are authoritative, as declared in root AGENTS.md OPENWIKI block and .agents/AGENTS.md routing directives.

Repository authority is zoned: portable prescriptive layer .agents (AGENTS.md, playbooks, skills, gitignored sessions) owns behavior rules, curated descriptive layer openwiki/decisions and troubleshooting holds OKF pages with aksk_status extensions preserved via the AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers owned by attach_wiki_contract.mjs, and root AGENTS.md is zoned baseline→OpenWiki→AKSK with marker-delimited AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE (owned by init_agents_md.mjs/refresh_agents_baseline.mjs), OPENWIKI:START/END (owned by OpenWiki tooling), and AKSK:ROUTING/AKSK:LIFECYCLE (owned by attach_section.mjs).

The kit ships Node ESM helpers under .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts including deterministic global orchestrator bootstrap-global.mjs plus bootstrap.mjs shim (global then repo), baseline helpers init_agents_md.mjs and refresh_agents_baseline.mjs, plus check_peer_tools.mjs, attach_wiki_contract.mjs, attach_section.mjs and sync_wiki_indexes.mjs, mirrored per-repo helpers under .agents/skills/aksk-init/scripts (bootstrap-repo.mjs, init_agents_md.mjs, attach_wiki_contract.mjs, attach_section.mjs), and two bash validators under scripts/ (check-agents-structure.sh portable and check-publish.sh release wrapper); all are idempotent, verification helpers never install, and missing prerequisites exit 2 with remediation while global lane falls back to INSTRUCT without partial state.

Maintenance loop is closeout → distill → sync → lint: task-closeout writes one five-file bundle under .agents/sessions/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-slug (summary.json, active-task.md, learning-candidate.md, changed-files.txt, validation.txt) with canonical task_id in summary.json, learning-distill classifies descriptive→openwiki vs prescriptive→.agents, sync_wiki_indexes.mjs rebuilds wiki indexes deterministically via OpenWikiLocalShellBackend (docsOnly/virtualMode) without invoking openwiki --update, and docs-lint guards wiring.

Root router marker blocks are owned by scripts: init_agents_md.mjs owns AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE seeded from references/agents-md-baseline-template.md (missing→create, match→no-op, mismatch→exit 2 with --replace/--combine), attach_section.mjs parses BEGIN/END markers from references/*-template.md (AKSK:ROUTING, AKSK:LIFECYCLE) and appends/refreshes below existing content idempotently, attach_wiki_contract.mjs appends/refreshes AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT between markers to existing openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md and exits 2 with openwiki --init if missing, and OPENWIKI:START/END is owned by OpenWiki tooling, in zoned order baseline→OpenWiki→AKSK.

Adoption is skill-first via npx skills add -g -a <self-reported> Hypercubed/Agent-Knowledge-Starter-Kit placing skills under ~/.agents/skills plus the self-reported host directory (repo-local .agents/skills only via override without -g); bootstrap-global.mjs provides global EXECUTE vs INSTRUCT lanes and bootstrap-repo.mjs provides per-repo sequencing (scaffold .agents/ + AGENTS.md baseline first, then openspec init --tools none, openwiki --init with harness vs CLI distinction, then routing/lifecycle and wiki-contract attachment) with detection-driven idempotency, preserving existing repo rules/playbooks/skills and not replacing .agents wholesale, with sessions/* gitignored.

Validators are deterministic and scoped: check-agents-structure.sh [target] (default .agents) checks required files, session tracking via git ls-files/git status --ignored, SKILL.md frontmatter and optional jq JSON validation; check-publish.sh cds to git root, delegates to it, then runs remark formatting (60s timeout), markdown-link-check --alive 200,0 (30s/file), rg leakage scans (warning) and doubled .agents/.agents hygiene (hard fail); package.json wires npm run check and npm run format to them.

Quickstart routes by intent through hierarchy without duplicating curated catalogs: task-routing table links to architecture overview, validation-and-release, bootstrap-and-attachment, task-lifecycle-and-distill, knowledge-curation-contract and distribution pages, while decisions/troubleshooting indexes are linked via overview pages and directory indexes rather than inline duplication.

OpenSpec source of truth is openspec/specs/** as shipped contract; openspec/changes/** are Proposal-only (not yet in specs) and openspec/changes/archive/** is historical until graduated to specs via openspec archive — wiki pages citing changes must label them Proposal-only and not present ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED as shipped.

Global lane is restricted to per-user operations per openspec/specs/aksk-bootstrap/spec.md (Node >=22 check, npm i -g for openspec/openwiki from caret ranges in references/versions.json, PATH verification, non-interactive with skill prompting), and per-repo initialization including AGENTS.md baseline first, openspec init, openwiki --init, routing/lifecycle and wiki-contract attachment is owned by openspec/specs/aksk-init/spec.md; host integrations (openwiki integrations install) are manual opt-in and not auto-installed by the global lane.

bootstrap.mjs shim at .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts/bootstrap.mjs runs the global lane then the per-repo lane sequentially when both trees are present (spawning bootstrap-global.mjs then bootstrap-repo.mjs), exiting with the first non-zero status and reporting aksk-init not found when absent.

Per-repo lane execution is non-interactive and fail-fast on global prerequisites: bootstrap-repo.mjs verifies openspec/openwiki on PATH, prints INSTRUCT npm i -g with caret versions from aksk-bootstrap/references/versions.json on exit 2 without attempting global installs, then scaffolds .agents/skills and .agents/sessions, seeds AGENTS.md baseline via init_agents_md.mjs, runs openspec init --tools none and openwiki --init (noting harness needs no extra key while CLI needs OPENAI_API_KEY), and attaches routing/lifecycle via attach_section.mjs and wiki contract via attach_wiki_contract.mjs.
